# Thanksgiving Hymns Column 9 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalent)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** 1QH (Cave 1), Col. 9 | **Condition:** Better preserved

---

**9:1** I give thanks to You, O Lord, for You have unsealed my ear to wondrous mysteries.

**9:2** And You have not stopped my ear against the chastening of [...] the upheavals of the age.

**9:3** For the spirit of flesh [...] amid the works of wickedness and transgression.

**9:4** I have held fast to Your covenant. And the truth that [...] You have implanted in my heart.

**9:5** And Your covenant-faithfulness for the deliverance of my soul, and the steps of my feet You have made firm.

**9:6** Against the dominion of wickedness. And You have made me a snare for transgressors.

**9:7** But a remedy for all who turn from transgression, and discernment for the simple.

**9:8** And a steadfast resolve for all the faint of heart. You have appointed me as a taunt and mockery for the treacherous.

**9:9** A counsel of truth and understanding for the upright of way.

**9:10** Against the schemes of the wicked I have become as one whom [...] reproach.

**9:11** Through me You have caused the faces of the Many to shine; You have multiplied Yourself beyond reckoning.

**9:12** For You have revealed to me Your wondrous mysteries.

**9:13** And in Your wondrous secret counsel You have displayed Your might through me.

**9:14** Working wonders before the Many for the sake of Your glory.

**9:15** And declaring Your mighty acts to all the living.

**9:16** What is flesh that You should act thus toward it? And how is a creature of clay able to accomplish great wonders?

**9:17** For it abides in iniquity from the womb, and in faithless guilt until old age.

**9:18** And I know that righteousness does not belong to a mortal, nor a blameless way to a son of man.

**9:19** To God Most High belong all righteous deeds, and the way of a mortal is not secure.

**9:20** Except by the spirit that God fashioned for him, to make the way perfect for the children of man.

**9:21** That all His works may know the power of His might and the fullness of His mercies.

**9:22** Upon all the children of His favor.

**9:23** And trembling and dread have seized me, and all my bones have shattered.

**9:24** And my heart has melted like wax before the fire, and my knees have become as water poured upon a slope.

**9:25** For I have recalled my acts of guilt together with the faithlessness of my forefathers.

**9:26** When the wicked rose up against Your covenant and the depraved against Your word.

**9:27** And I said, for my transgression I have been abandoned from Your covenant.

**9:28** But when I remembered the might of Your hand together with the fullness of Your mercies.

**9:29** I rose and stood firm, and my spirit maintained its stand before affliction.

**9:30** For I have leaned upon Your covenant-faithfulness and upon the abundance of Your compassion.

**9:31** For You make atonement for iniquity and purify humanity by Your righteousness from [...] transgression.

**9:32** Not for man's sake but for the sake of Your glory. For You have fashioned the righteous and the wicked.

**9:33** And You have established the spirit of [...] and the design of [...] from before the ages.

**9:34** And the judgment of all and the duty of [...] You have apportioned through all their generations.

**9:35** Performing wonders before the Many for the sake of Your glory and making known Your mighty acts.

**9:36** To all the living, that all may know Your might and the fullness of Your mercies upon all the children of Your favor.

**9:37** And I, Your servant, have come to know by the spirit that You have placed in me that Your words are truth, and all Your works are righteousness.

---

*LOGOS notes: Column 9 is theologically dense. "The Many" (ha-rabbim) is the Qumran community designation. "Caused the faces of the Many to shine" (9:11) echoes the Aaronic blessing. The anthropological pessimism (9:16-19) is among the most pronounced in Second Temple Judaism. The closing confession (9:37) anticipates John 17:17.*
